experiment: SG31 SeeDiff-inspired coarse-to-fine reseeding and explicit background propagation
provenance: SeeDiff-inspired mechanisms adapted to our A3 class-conditioned SD1.5 attention segmentation pipeline; not SeeDiff end-to-end
ca: historical A3 selected 11 CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads, class-word W, existing normalization, no 32x32 CA restoration
sa: SG25 16x16/32x32/64x64 modules, same call 10-20 inclusive, all eight heads; selected-row expansion uses head-mean SA; continuous controls use SG25 per-head semantics
seed_threshold_provenance: SeeDiff paper Section 4.1 states alpha=0.5; not tuned
normalization: spatial minmax after each hard/soft scale expansion before reseeding; final spatial minmax after call averaging; F(1-B) final minmax; R2 unchanged
orientation: selected-row E(S)=mean_{p in S} A[p,:], as in SeeDiff equation 7; historical continuous control is A @ c
s0: same-generation historical FINE-P2, mean over call/head A64 squared c
s2: continuous 16-to-32-to-64, same call, three SA applications
s6_s7: historical FINE-P2 foreground gated by one-step selected-row or observation-wise A64 squared background
s8_s9: S3 or S4 foreground gated by one-step selected-row background
s10: normalized square of historical foreground, inversion-only sharpening control
selection: five fixed VOC folds; separate raw/R2 selectors and forced OOF; same registered promotion guard; full VOC threshold frozen for COCO, no COCO tuning
storage: per-image metric counts, per-call seed statistics and aggregate GT-posthoc transition/background diagnostics; no images, maps, masks, attention matrices or QK persisted
